ezekiel.23.p1.b1.text: Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother… Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.

ezekiel.23.p1.b2.text: Oholah prostituted herself while she was still Mine. She lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians—warriors clothed in blue… horsemen mounted on steeds.

ezekiel.23.p1.b3.text: Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, the Assyrians for whom she lusted.

ezekiel.23.p1.b4.text: She saw the men portrayed on the wall, images of the Chaldeans, engraved in vermilion, wearing belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like officers…

ezekiel.23.p1.b5.text: At the sight of them, she lusted for them and sent messengers to them in Chaldea.

ezekiel.23.p2.b1.text: I will incite your lovers against you, those from whom you turned away in disgust. And I will bring them against you from every side…

ezekiel.23.p2.b2.text: They will strip off your clothes and take your fine jewelry.

ezekiel.23.p2.b3.text: You will drink your sister’s cup, a cup deep and wide. It will bring scorn and derision, for it holds so much.

ezekiel.23.p2.b4.text: You will drink it and drain it…

ezekiel.23.p2.b5.text: On the very day they slaughtered their children for their idols, they entered My sanctuary to profane it.

ezekiel.23.p2.b6.text: They will repay you for your indecency, and you will bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”
